about_tagline: A private, local-first client for multiple mailboxes
project_intro_body: BondMail is an open-source mail client built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. Mail, contacts, and settings are primarily stored on your device, and the app does not operate a mail relay server.
open_source_licenses_desc: Major third-party components used by this app
app_license_desc: This project is released under the MIT License
privacy_policy_desc: How the app handles your data
project_home_desc: View source code and report issues on GitHub
external_link_open_failed: Unable to open the external link
open_source_statement: BondMail thanks the open-source community. This page lists the major third-party components used directly by the app. Copyright remains with their respective authors.
open_source_notice: This convenient summary does not replace the complete copyright and license files distributed with each dependency. The upstream project terms govern.
privacy_local_body: Mailbox configuration, cached mail, contacts, drafts, and app settings are stored in the app's private local storage to support mail delivery and offline reading.
privacy_network_body: The app connects directly to the IMAP/SMTP servers you choose. Google or Microsoft sign-in also connects to the corresponding provider for authorization. BondMail does not relay mail through a developer-operated server.
privacy_credentials_body: App passwords and custom-mail credentials are encrypted with Android Keystore before local storage. Google and Microsoft tokens are managed by provider sign-in components and their secure caches. BondMail never receives your provider website password.
privacy_remote_images_body: Loading a remote image in mail can disclose your IP address, access time, and network details to the image server. You can choose Always, Wi-Fi only, or Never in Settings. External links are handed to another app only after confirmation.
privacy_permissions_body: Notification permission displays new-mail alerts. Foreground service, boot, and wake-lock access support background checks at your selected interval.
privacy_delete_body: Deleting a mailbox or contact removes its local profile and does not delete mail from the server. Clearing app data or uninstalling removes all local cache and settings.
privacy_no_tracking_body: BondMail contains no ads, integrates no developer-operated analytics or tracking service, and does not sell personal data.
privacy_contact_body: For privacy or license questions, open an Issue on the BondMail GitHub project page.
